Alternative NFKB pathway and its components affected by germline mutations

Schematic representation of the alternative NF-κB pathway and its components affected by germline mutations.(A) Components and regulation of the alternative NF-kB signaling pathway, with the corresponding human inborn errors, indicated by red dots. (B) Schematic representation of the proteins and their corresponding reported variants. ARD, ankyrin repeat domain; HLH, helix-loop-helix; KD, kinase domain; LZ, leucine zipper; NBD, NEMO-binding domain; NCR, non-catalytic region; NRD, negative regulatory domain; NRS, NIK-responsive sequence; PID, processing inhibitory domain; RHD, Rel homology domain; TAD, transactivation domain
